svg.title: Ashford Vale - Ashford Town
svg.text: Numbers on the plan = building ID (T-###).
359 buildings inside the walls; every house
has a named resident and trade in buildings.csv.
Streets: High St 9 m, Market St 8 m, lanes 5 m.
Town wall 8 m high with 4 gatehouses.
Your house: Steward's Hall, on the market square.
